note: Starter rule cards. Each cites a source id from source-manifest.json. Evidence labels follow the README: documented | observed | inferred | unsafe/unverified. Cards are not enforced by code yet.

cards.rule: Ignore fuel corrections smaller than the sensor's stated accuracy at that lambda.
Trust lambda only when the sensor is mounted near vertical with the wire up, with no exhaust leak upstream, away from the tailpipe, and below 2.5 bar exhaust pressure.
Know injector flow at a stated pressure and dead time against battery voltage before tuning idle and cruise; otherwise dead-time error is baked into the base map.
Confirm commanded ignition timing with a timing light before any ignition change.

source.location: Step: set base ignition timing and fuel pressure

cards.rule: Read whether the ECU's own learning correction is active before comparing runs or proposing fuel changes.
cards.notes: The book describes learning correction in the creator's design; how FC-03 exposes it must be observed on the unit.

cards.rule: Correct measured power to reference conditions before comparing runs on different days.
Never propose a change to a table whose axes, units and scaling are not defined in the map description.
